_comment: Phase 10 locks the door. Ten counters are HARD ZERO and the ratchet fails CI on any non-zero (as / ts_ignore / biome_ignore_line / biome_ignore_all / interface / object_type / eslint_disable / any / invariant_calls / redundant_annotations). Two counters stay on NO-INCREASE semantics because they mix legitimate uses (per R0.2's allowed list) with violations: `never` and `unknown` — the baseline is the floor; numbers only move DOWN. Counts are source-only — dist/ and *.d.ts are excluded. A small audited set of lines is allowed to violate R1/R4 because the rule's narrow exception list applies (recursive Valibot schema anchors, declaration merging on built-in globals, irreducible mapped-tuple boundary in `decode_function_result`); they are tagged with `// allow-violation: <tag>` on the line immediately above and the ratchet strips them before counting. See skills/no-violations/SKILL.md.
_never_history: Previous bumps logged in this file's git history. The counter only moves DOWN; intentional rises require a one-line `_never_bump_<date>_<reason>` key alongside the new number, mirroring the historical `_unknown_bump_2026_05_25_bytes64` entry below.
_unknown_bump_2026_05_25_bytes64: 199 → 200: new bytes64Schema in @ethernauta/core adds one isBytes64(input: unknown) predicate, matching every other bytesN file in the package.
_unknown_bump_2026_05_29_7677_context: 200 → 201: ERC-7677 ContextSchema = record(string(), unknown()). The paymaster-service context is paymaster-defined and opaque per spec — there is no narrower expressible value type at this boundary.
